evidence_sentence: It validates the file extension against allowed types if the protocol is file.
rationale: The fixed implementation adds an allowed-extension check for file protocols using c->allowed_extensions and av_match_ext(). The vulnerable implementation permits file URLs without validating their extensions. The quoted Logic sentence therefore describes only the fixed security behavior.
rewritten_docstring: The function checks the protocol of the provided URL, ensuring it is either HTTP or a file type. It attempts to open the URL using the specified options and updates cookies if the URL is HTTP. The function also manages temporary dictionaries for options and cleans up resources before returning the result of the opening operation.
